# SIPI

> Learn signal and power integrity through clear explanations, engineering examples, and interactive browser-based models.

Created and directed by Geetansh Arora, Principal SI/PI Engineer. The site states model assumptions and evidence explicitly. Educational models do not establish standards compliance, measurement correlation, or suitability for design sign-off outside their documented scope.

## Start here

- [Learning paths](https://sipi.work/start.html): Guided routes for students, practising SI and PI engineers, and board debug.
- [Interactive labs](https://sipi.work/labs.html): Long-form labs for transmission lines, channel response, and PDN behavior.
- [Calculators](https://sipi.work/calculators.html): Twelve SI and PI calculators, each with its formula, assumptions and a live chart.
- [Reference](https://sipi.work/reference.html): SI/PI symbols, formulas, assumptions, and unit tools.
- [Model assumptions and evidence](https://sipi.work/model-contract.html): Scope, equations, numerics, limitations, and supporting checks for each interactive model.
- [About, review, and attribution](https://sipi.work/colophon.html): Authorship, review status, sources, licenses, and AI-assistance disclosure.

Vocabulary, conventions, and mathematical connections used throughout the site.
